_comment: WHETHER A SCENERY PIECE IS WALL SCENERY, when the Game Master says the agent's tag is wrong (maintainer 2026-08-28: 'I can see that you have tagged some scenery as wall scenery that is not wall scenery and I can also find scenery that IS wall scenery, but you think it's not'). Wall scenery hangs on a house/mountain/cave wall, needs no hitbox, and is never y-sorted against the player. The agent's own tag is the piece's type (MOUNTAIN_WALL and WINDOW read as wall scenery); an entry here OVERRIDES it. Keyed by the piece's path: overrides['scenery/<category>/<piece>'] = { wall: true|false, was: '<the type the tag said>', updated_at }. Absent means the tag is right. Written by the wiki's Scenery review; consumed by the scenery agent, which re-files the piece's type and deletes the entry - the same contract as scenery_lights. See live/README.md.
